incident_text: A building is burning and firefighters are working on it.

result.scene_summary: A house is on fire with large black smoke billowing from it, and firefighters are operating a hose from a grassy slope below.

observations.description: Large plume of dark, thick smoke rising from the building.
Bright orange flames visible through the windows and roof of the building.
Roof and walls of the building appear damaged and partially collapsed.
Three figures in firefighter gear are visible on the grassy slope, operating a hose.
No visible vehicles in the image.
Trees and shrubs are visible surrounding the building and slope.
